title: A Minor Solar Storm Destroyed 38 Brand-New Starlink Satellites

scenes.text: A minor solar storm destroyed 38 brand-new satellites in days.
In February 2022, SpaceX launched 49 Starlink satellites.
A day later, a solar storm hit Earth.
It heated the upper air, which swelled up and dragged on the satellites.
Thirty-eight of them fell back and burned up in the atmosphere.
The storm was rated minor. Imagine a big one.

description:
In February 2022, SpaceX launched 49 Starlink satellites. A minor solar storm struck the next day.
The storm swelled Earth's upper air, and 38 satellites were dragged down and burned up.
What would a major storm do?
first_comment: Should we worry about the next big solar storm?
